songs.title: Risky or Dangerous? 🛹
lines: Why do some people do dangerous things?
For the thrill and the reward it brings!
A wild bear is dangerous — it can hurt you!
Jumping a ramp is risky — you choose to go!
You might lose something, but you choose it!
A daredevil's stunt — would you try it, too?
I'm not a wimp, I think it through,
It's risky, not dangerous — so I'll try!
n: 곡조: Rap chant (4 beats) — 멜로디 없이 4박으로 읊는 챈트, 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
dangerous에서 두 손으로 X, risky에서 손바닥을 저울처럼 흔들어 구분하기
songs.imgPrompt: A kid in a helmet jumping a small skateboard ramp while friends cheer from a safe distance.

songs.title: Fate or Free Will? 🔮
lines: Could that really happen? Is it possible?
A dragon talks to a princess — made-up!
A biography of a scientist — true!
Going to the moon is a realistic dream.
Everything is already decided — fate?
Or my choices make my future — free will!
Which do you believe in more? Why?
I choose my future — I believe in free will!
n: 곡조: Clap chant (4 beats) — 멜로디 없이 4박으로 읊는 챈트, 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
fiction에서 마법 지팡이 흉내, non-fiction(true)에서 책을 펴는 동작으로 구분하기
songs.imgPrompt: Children reading a storybook with a talking dragon and princess next to a real science biography.

songs.title: Not Good at It... Yet! 🌱
lines: I'm good at drawing, yes!
I'm good at math, oh yes!
Not good at singing yet,
I need to practice more.
A strength, a weakness too,
Determination grows,
Fulfill your potential,
With practice, dreams come true!
n: 곡조: The Farmer in the Dell (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
good at에서 엄지 척, yet에서 손가락으로 '아직' 표시, grows에서 새싹처럼 몸 펴기
songs.imgPrompt: Kids drawing, doing math and practicing singing beside a small seed sprouting into a plant.
